1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.UniqueRouteCutVertex
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.JunctionFan
3 
4 /-! For a source cofacial with every original vertex, all original
5 nonsource vertices are leaves. Every internal junction therefore has
6 the flat fan already constructed for the wedge-chain argument. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
9 
10 open Set
11 
12 namespace EmbeddedCutGraph
13 
14 /-- At least two original nonsource vertices occur among the cut-graph vertices. -/
15 theorem vertices_nontrivial {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body}
16     (K : P.EmbeddedCutGraph a) : Nontrivial K.vertices := by
17   classical
18   have enough : 1 < (P.vertices.erase (a : Space)).card := by
19     have lower := P.four_le_vertex_count
20     have bound := Finset.pred_card_le_card_erase (s := P.vertices) (a := (a : Space))
21     omega
22   obtain ⟨v, hv, w, hw, different⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp enough
23   have first := K.original_vertex_mem (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2 (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).1
24   have second := K.original_vertex_mem (Finset.mem_erase.mp hw).2 (Finset.mem_erase.mp hw).1
25   exact ⟨⟨⟨v, first⟩, ⟨w, second⟩, fun same => different (congrArg Subtype.val same)⟩⟩
26 
27 end EmbeddedCutGraph
28 
29 namespace SixVertexGraph
30 
31 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
32   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
33     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
34 
35 include graph small_faces in
36 /-- A unique-route cut-tree vertex is a leaf, in the exact one-neighbor sense. -/
37 theorem unique_route_cut_vertex_is_leaf (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
38     (u : T.vertices) (unique : (P.geodesicFiber a (T.vertexTarget u)).Subsingleton) :
39     ∃! v, T.graph.Adj u v := by
40   letI : Nontrivial T.vertices := T.toEmbeddedCutGraph.vertices_nontrivial
41   obtain ⟨v, edge⟩ := T.tree.connected.preconnected.exists_adj_of_nontrivial u
42   exact ⟨v, edge, fun w other =>
43     graph.unique_route_cut_vertex_at_most_one_neighbor small_faces a T u unique w v other edge⟩
44 
45 include graph small_faces in
46 /-- If the source shares a face with every original vertex, the leaves
47 are precisely the original nonsource vertices. -/
48 theorem cofacial_source_leaf_iff_original (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
49     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
50     (u : T.vertices) : (∃! v, T.graph.Adj u v) ↔ (u : Space) ∈ P.vertices := by
51   constructor
52   · rintro ⟨v, edge, only_neighbor⟩
53     exact graph.cut_graph_leaf_is_vertex small_faces a T.toEmbeddedCutGraph u v edge only_neighbor
54   · intro original
55     obtain ⟨F, source, target⟩ := cofacial ⟨u, original⟩
56     exact graph.unique_route_cut_vertex_is_leaf small_faces a T u
57       (P.geodesicFiber_cofacial_unique a (T.vertexTarget u) F source target)
58 
59 include graph small_faces in
60 /-- An actual passage between distinct incident edges cannot be at an
61 original vertex for a cofacial source. -/
62 theorem cofacial_source_internal_vertex_nonvertex (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
63     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
64     (u v w : T.vertices) (first : T.graph.Adj u v) (second : T.graph.Adj u w)
65     (different : v ≠ w) : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices := by
66   intro original
67   obtain ⟨F, source, target⟩ := cofacial ⟨u, original⟩
68   exact different (graph.cofacial_cut_vertex_at_most_one_neighbor small_faces a T u
69     F source target v w first second)
70 
71 include graph small_faces in
72 /-- The real flat fan exists at every internal tree-path junction;
73 there is no remaining singular-junction premise in this cofacial case. -/
74 theorem cofacial_source_internal_junction_fan (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
75     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
76     (u v w : T.vertices) (first : T.graph.Adj u v) (second : T.graph.Adj u w)
77     (different : v ≠ w) : Nonempty (JunctionFan T u) :=
78   graph.exists_junction_fan small_faces a T u
79     (graph.cofacial_source_internal_vertex_nonvertex small_faces a T cofacial u v w first second different)
80 
81 end SixVertexGraph
82 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
